title: ASCII and Unicode boundary cases
description: Implement shift_ascii(text,step): rotate ASCII A–Z and a–z independently by step (any integer); leave digits, punctuation and all other Unicode characters unchanged. Return [shifted_text,character_count,utf8_byte_count] for the result. Use ord/chr for shifts. In your notes explain why a Unicode character and a UTF-8 byte are not interchangeable.
hints: Separate validation, state changes and output.
Try an empty case, an exact boundary and repeated operations.
rubric: Explain code points versus UTF-8 bytes using the non-ASCII example.
